messages.subject: Cannot plot figures ...
parts:
Greetings all:

 Am running BGB in R-Studio (macOS Mojave 10.14.6).

Difficulties arise when I try and plot ancestral states and pie-chart tree, regardless of the model (DEC … Divalike … Bayarealike … etc.). Nothing emerges.

Obviously there’s something (… R-related?) that is hanging me up here.

Was wondering if anyone had a similar issue and if so, was able to resolve it?

Many thanks for a response … /M.

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Cannot plot figures ...
parts:
Hi -- probably you are running the part of the code that opens a PDF for writing, e.g.:

#######################################################
# PDF plots
#######################################################
pdffn = "Psychotria_DEC_vs_DEC+J_M0_unconstrained_v1.pdf"
pdf(pdffn, width=6, height=6)

...but not the part of the code that closes the writing of the PDF, and then opens the PDF for viewing...

dev.off()  # Turn off PDF
cmdstr = paste("open ", pdffn, sep="")
system(cmdstr) # Plot it

Just type dev.off() a couple of times to close any previously-opened PDFs/graphics devices, then either (a) do all of the PDF opening/closing commands, or (b) skip the PDF-related commands to plot to the R graphics window.

Cheers,
Nick
